about: CI3's acceptance tests (land.py --moved-from: a candidate C moved over landing commits only lands on its source X's two reviews and X's green CI run; owner's decision, 2026-10-14) that failed when the independent test author wrote them, before the implementation, at 367d1368 (scripts/rust_core/land_selftest.py, the 'moved:' cases; their interface in the comment above them). 'cases' holds self-test names. land_selftest.py's main holds each listed case to failing (strict): once one passes it fails, naming itself, until the implementer takes it out of 'pending'. The implementer changes nothing else: 'pending' stays within 'authored', which is the test author's. The test author added the coordinator's cases on e0b081aa (chained moves under the generalized rule replacing conditions 3 and 4; the subagent review's lone carriage return and whitespace-only intermediate commit, refused by a per-commit tree check; the Moved-from and Moved-from-run trailers, asserted in the renamed landing-message case); those failing on e0b081aa are pending. land_selftest.py's moved cases now run land.py's own command runner in the repository, and the condition-4 cases accept a refusal naming the landing commits, the patches or the trees.
